en: The image shows a black-and-white photograph of a stone plaque embedded in a rough stone wall. The plaque has a decorative scroll-like border and contains a Latin inscription. The text begins with 'URBANUS EPISCOPUS SERVUS SERVORUM DEI' and references a decree dated 1367 in Viterbo, Italy, under the papacy of Urban V. The content and style suggest it is a commemorative plaque about the establishment or recognition of a Studium Generale (a medieval university or center of learning).
